backend: X11 / in-process GPU / Mesa desktop OpenGL 4.6; capture replay, not original GLES timing

counters.name: GPU Duration
counters.description: Time taken for this event on the GPU, as measured by delta between two GPU timestamps.

counters.name: Samples Passed
counters.description: Number of samples that passed depth/stencil test.

counters.name: Input Vertices Read
counters.description: Number of vertices read by input assembler.

counters.name: Input Primitives
counters.description: Number of primitives read by the input assembler.

counters.name: GS Primitives
counters.description: Number of primitives output by a geometry shader.

counters.name: Rasterizer Invocations
counters.description: Number of primitives that were sent to the rasterizer.

counters.name: Rasterized Primitives
counters.description: Number of primitives that were rendered.

counters.name: VS Invocations
counters.description: Number of times a vertex shader was invoked.

counters.name: TCS Invocations
counters.description: Number of times a tesselation control shader was invoked.

counters.name: TES Invocations
counters.description: Number of times a tesselation evaluation shader was invoked.

counters.name: GS Invocations
counters.description: Number of times a geometry shader was invoked.

counters.name: PS Invocations
counters.description: Number of times a pixel shader was invoked.

counters.name: CS Invocations
counters.description: Number of times a compute shader was invoked.
